gates.evidence: Proposal targets screen s21 (Favorite messages), which is an SFW surface.
Proposal rewards 5 bonus chat messages via a 15-s game with Luzia; no clicks, installs, or cash-like items.
Offer copy uses gain framing ('Play a quick game... for 5 bonus messages') with no dark patterns or confirmshaming.
Uses SIM-RWD with an explicit CTA 'Play Now' and a button entry point.
Offer title 'Get Bonus Messages' and body clearly state the reward and required action prior to viewing.
Provides an equally legible decline button 'No Thanks' that returns the user without penalty.
Triggered after dismissing the signup wall on s21, not during an AI text stream.
Guard restricts eligibility to guest users who do not have account access (r2 < 1).

scores.evidence: Proposal targets s21 (Favorite messages wall) and offers bonus messages (r3). While s21 is an account signup wall for saving messages rather than a direct quota cap, offering a refill fallback is a reasonable engagement moment.
Proposal preserves user flow, uses an in-world game partner ('Luzia'), and operates on an SFW surface without degrading core functionality.
Gated to guest users (r2 < 1), grants temporary usage quota (r3) rather than permanent account access (r2), and is capped at 1 per day.
Economics code flags: Cost to serve the reward ($0.0090) exceeds net revenue per view ($0.0063) at the low end due to 5 text-cheap messages.
Targeting users hitting the Favorite messages wall (m5, reach=frequent) captures a recurring friction point.
Maps directly to SIM-RWD unit, button entry, and resource r3 with a clean patch adding ne1 to s21.
Uses app-specific screen s21 ('Favorite messages'), resource r3, and gamePartner 'Luzia'.
Caps usage explicitly at perDay: 1 and cooldownMin: 60.
Defines primary conversion metric, guardrails, and a 5% user-level holdout for 30 days.

requiredChanges: Reduce the reward size from 5 messages to 2–3 messages (or switch to an ultra-cheap model) so that the cost to serve ($0.0090) does not exceed net revenue per view ($0.0063).
Ensure the reward more closely aligns with the wall's specific blocked feature on s21 (e.g., temporary message saving or preview slot) or frame the quota refill clearly.
